title: Project & Creative Operations Lead
description:
**About TripleDart**
--------------------

TripleDart Digital is an AI-native, full-funnel growth agency built for B2B SaaS. We run paid media, ABM, SEO/GEO, creative, web/CRO and RevOps for 100+ SaaS brands scaling from $5M to $100M+ ARR across the US, Europe and APAC. Clients measure us on qualified pipeline and revenue influenced, and we hold Google Premier, HubSpot Platinum and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status.

Our paid media and ABM programs generate a steady stream of creative work — ad concepts, static and video assets, landing pages, ABM personalization, reporting dashboards. Delivering that at scale, to a US client's expectations, is an operations problem. This role owns it.

**Role Summary**
----------------

You are accountable for the entire paid media and creative operations layer: intake, scoping, scheduling, capacity, SLAs, QC and delivery across the portfolio. Account managers own the client relationship and strategy; you own that what we committed gets built correctly and ships on time.

This is a run-the-system-and-make-it-better role. You've managed delivery at scale before, you know what a healthy ClickUp board looks like, and you don't wait for a miss to find out a process is broken.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

### **Project management across the portfolio**

* Own intake to delivery for every paid media, ABM and creative request across ~15 accounts: scoping, briefs, estimates, scheduling, dependencies and sign-off.
* Run the weekly delivery rhythm — sprint planning, daily stand-ups with pods and creative, and a Friday portfolio review of what shipped, what slipped and why.
* Maintain a single, current view of every account's open work, due dates and blockers that an account manager or founder can read in 30 seconds.

### **SLAs and quality control**

* Define and enforce SLAs by deliverable type (ad copy, statics, video, landing pages, dashboards, campaign builds) and report adherence weekly.
* Build and run the QC layer: checklists, review gates and sign-off before anything reaches a client. Brand, copy, spec, tracking and link checks are non-negotiable.
* Track rework and client-reported misses as a defect rate, root-cause them and close the loop with the function that caused them.

### **Creative operations**

* Own the creative pipeline end to end: briefing standards, asset specs per channel (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, CTV), versioning, approvals and asset handoff to paid media.
* Balance load across copy, design, video and web/dev; forecast creative demand from the media plan and staff or reprioritise ahead of the crunch.
* Maintain the creative library, naming conventions and templates so nothing ships off-brand or off-spec.

### **Capacity planning and ClickUp hygiene**

* ClickUp is the source of truth and you keep it that way: every task scoped, owned, estimated, dated and in the right status. No work outside the system.
* Run capacity planning per pod and per function against the retainer scope; flag over-servicing and under-utilisation to leadership monthly.
* Own time-tracking discipline and the utilisation and SLA dashboards leadership uses to run the BU.

### **Client communication**

* Be the delivery voice on client accounts alongside the account manager: status updates, timelines, revision rounds and expectation-setting on what ships when.
* Handle client-facing delivery escalations directly and proactively — before the client raises them.

### **Cross-functional problem solving**

* Sit between account management, paid media pods, copy, design, dev and analytics. When something is stuck, you unblock it, and you fix the process so it doesn't stick again.
* Document and improve SOPs for recurring work; bring AI and automation (ClickUp automations, n8n, Claude) into intake, QC and reporting to cut manual effort.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

Delivery is under control when the client never has to ask where something is.

KPI

Target

What it measures

  

On-time delivery

95%+ of deliverables shipped by committed date

Scheduling and dependency control across the portfolio

  

SLA adherence

95%+ by deliverable type, reported weekly

Turnaround commitments kept per account

  

QC pass rate

98%+ first-pass; zero client-reported brand, spec or tracking errors

Quality gates working before work reaches the client

  

Rework rate

Under 10% of creative deliverables needing a second revision round

Briefing quality and QC discipline

  

ClickUp hygiene

100% of active work scoped, owned, estimated and dated; weekly audit score

The system reflects reality

  

Capacity utilisation

Pods and creative functions within 90–95% planned utilisation; over-servicing flagged monthly

Retainer scope matched to effort

  

Client delivery satisfaction

4.5+ / 5 on delivery and communication in QBR feedback

Clients trust the process, not just the people

  

Process improvement

At least one SOP or automation shipped per month with measured time saved

The system gets better, not just maintained

Targets are reviewed quarterly with the Head of Paid Media and feed the BU's business review.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Non-negotiables**

* 5–8 years in project, delivery or operations management, with at least 3 years running delivery at scale — 10+ concurrent client accounts or 50+ live deliverables a month — at a marketing agency, creative studio or SaaS marketing team.
* A recognized PM certification: PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM/PSM or equivalent. Google Project Management or ClickUp certifications are a plus on top, not a substitute.
* Expert in ClickUp or an equivalent (Asana, Monday, Jira) — you've designed the workspace, the custom fields, the automations and the dashboards, not just used them.
* Hands-on experience running creative operations: briefing, asset specs across paid channels, review and approval cycles, and managing designers, copywriters and video editors' load.
* Working knowledge of paid media and ABM delivery — what a campaign build, a landing page or a reporting dashboard needs before it can ship — enough to QC it and estimate it.
* Accountability as a reflex. You have owned delivery outcomes personally, carried the miss, and fixed the process after.
* Clear, direct written and spoken English; you write client status updates and run calls with US stakeholders.
* Comfortable with US-overlap hours (2:00–11:00 PM IST) and a fully remote, cross-functional team.

### **Strong plusses**

* Six Sigma, Lean or ITIL exposure; you think in defect rates and cycle times.
* Experience with capacity planning and utilisation reporting against retainer scopes.
* Familiarity with Figma, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4 and Looker Studio.
* Experience building ClickUp or n8n automations, or using Claude/ChatGPT to speed up intake, QC and reporting.
* Prior ownership of SOP libraries, onboarding playbooks or delivery handbooks.

### **How you work**

You are organized to the point of being predictable, and the team relies on that. You communicate early, especially bad news. You solve the problem in front of you and then remove the cause. You hold a standard without needing to be the loudest person on the call.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **Own the whole system.** Paid media and creative operations across the portfolio report into you — not a slice of one account.
* **Scale that matters.** 15 accounts, six delivery pods and a creative team shipping for US SaaS brands scaling to $100M+ ARR.
* **Build with AI.** We use Claude, n8n and ClickUp automations in delivery today; you'll have the mandate and budget to push that further.
* **A direct line to leadership.** You report to the Co-Founder running the BU; your dashboards are the ones the business is run on.
* **A clear path.** This role grows into Head of Delivery / Operations as the BU scales.

**Working setup and benefits**
------------------------------

* Fully remote. Work from anywhere in India.
* Fixed US-overlap shift: 2:00–11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday, so you cover the India afternoon handoff and the full US morning.
* Learning and development budget — PM and platform certifications, courses and conferences.
* Full access to TripleDart's AI-native tooling stack (Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, n8n and internal platforms).
* Health insurance and wellbeing support [confirm plan details with HR].

**How to apply**
----------------

**Apply through Keka, or email your resume and cover letter to mailto:sabari@tripledart.com.**

description:

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Job Title Environment Manager**

**Location**

India / 4 days per week in the office / 1 day WFH

**Department**

Group Enterprise Applications / HR Technology

**Role Purpose**

The **Environment Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day coordination, governance, and operational health of all Workday and Salesforce environments (Production and non‑Production). This role ensures environments are correctly configured, available, and aligned to release, testing, and change activities across all stakeholders.

The position acts as the central point of coordination between internal teams, system integrators, Workday and Salesforce, ensuring environment usage is controlled, compliant, and supports business delivery without risk to Production stability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Environment Strategy & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and maintain the environment strategy across Workday and Salesforce, ensuring optimal allocation of environments to projects, testing cycles, and BAU needs.
* Identify opportunities to reduce environment conflicts, improve deployment speed, and increase testing effectiveness.
* Drive automation and tooling improvements to streamline refresh, configuration validation, and release readiness.
* Maintain environment documentation, landscape diagrams, and operational runbooks.

**Workday-Salesforce Environment Management**

* Coordinate and oversee all Workday-Salesforce environments (e.g. Production, Sandbox, Implementation, Testing).
* Manage the end‑to‑end environment lifecycle strategy (planning, forecasting, optimisation)
* Maintain clear ownership, purpose, and usage rules for each environment.
* Ensure environments are appropriately refreshed, prepared, and validated for testing and release activities.
* Responsibility for coordinating environment dependencies between Workday, Salesforce, integration platforms, and downstream systems.
* Monitor environment availability, performance, and readiness in line with business needs.

**Release & Change Coordination**

* Coordinate Workday bi-annual releases across environments, including readiness activities, testing cycles, and deployment sequencing.
* Coordinate Salesforce seasonal releases (Spring, Summer, Winter).
* Oversee change freeze management and ensure communication of blackout windows.
* Manage early adopter tenants (Workday Preview, Salesforce sandboxes).
* Provide risk assessments related to environment or release conflicts.
* Manage environment schedules to support parallel initiatives (projects, enhancements, BAU changes).
* Act as a key interface between change management, HRIS, Finance Systems, and technical teams.
* Ensure changes are promoted through environments in line with governance and controls.

**Testing & Deployment Support**

* Plan and coordinate environment usage for unit, system, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Ensure environments are correctly configured and data is suitable for testing purposes.
* Support defect triage and resolution related to environment configuration or refresh activities.
* Coordinate go‑live cutovers from non‑Production to Production environments.

**Governance & Controls**

* Define and maintain the environment architecture, including naming conventions, data refresh rules, branching/tenant strategy.
* Maintain alignment with IT security, data masking, integration architecture.
* Partner with solution architects to ensure changes align to environment strategy.
* Enforce environment access controls and usage standards.
* Support audit, compliance, and risk activities related to Workday and Salesforce environments.
* Maintain documentation covering environment strategy, refresh cycles, and operating procedures.
* Ensure alignment with internal IT controls and Workday / Salesforce best practices.

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for environment-related queries.
* Act as the operational owner during high‑severity environment incidents.
* Coordinate with Workday-Salesforce and Tech teams for environment issues and requests.
* Communicate environment availability, constraints, and changes to impacted stakeholders.

**Key Skills & Experience**

* Experience working with Workday environments (HCM, Financials, Adaptive).
* Experience working with CRM Salesforce (SalesCloud).
* Experience with integration platforms (ex: Boomi, MuleSoft, Workday Studio, APIs).
* Salesforce deployment tooling (ex: Gearset, DevOps Center).
* Strong understanding of enterprise system lifecycles, testing phases, and release management.
* Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders across IT, HR, Finance, and Data Governance.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a complex, multi‑initiative landscape.

* Experience in HRIS, ERP, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Familiarity with Workday releases, tenants, and environment refresh processes.
* Ability to run complex environment calendars across multiple workstreams.
* Experience with incident and problem management.
* Comfortable working in large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Exposure to audit, compliance, or SOX‑controlled environments.
* Familiarity with Jira, ADO, or equivalent for work management.
* Experience working with system integrators or managed service providers.

* Structured, methodical, and delivery‑focused
* Strong communicator with the ability to translate technical concepts for non‑technical stakeholders
* Naturally collaborative with a strong service mindset

description:

**About Us**

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

**Job Description**

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
* Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
* Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
* Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
* Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
* Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
* Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.

* Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.

* Coordinating recruitment, financial administration, suppliers or marketing delivery.

* Close collaboration with the CEO and visibility across the startup.
* Meaningful ownership of operational work and process improvements.
* A broad role combining executive support, team coordination and practical AI use.
* A fully remote working arrangement.
* Monthly compensation in USD.

You will work remotely and maintain clear visibility of priorities, progress and blockers. Reliable communication, organised documentation and consistent follow-through are essential. Working hours and required availability will be agreed during the hiring process.

Please submit your CV and describe relevant examples of work you have personally delivered. **Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** India  
**Department:** Human Resources

Pioneer Global Solutions provides technology solutions and services to organisations across India, including software licensing, cloud solutions, business email, workforce management, remote desktop, data backup, cybersecurity, and AI.

We work with leading technology providers, including AWS, Yotta, Microsoft, Adobe, Autodesk, Google Workspace, greytHR, TSplus, eScan, Palo Alto Networks, and Central360.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on **HR Manager with strong expertise in Recruitment and Talent Acquisition**to lead end-to-end hiring across our technical, sales, and corporate functions.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing the complete recruitment lifecycle independently, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing candidates to interview coordination, offer negotiation, and successful onboarding.

This role requires a target-oriented professional with excellent communication skills, strong follow-up discipline, and the ability to build a consistent pipeline of quality candidates while managing essential HR operations.

Key Responsibilities1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement gathering and job posting to candidate selection, offer release, and joining.

* Proactively address offer dropouts and improve candidate engagement and offer-to-joining conversion.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies for specialised and hard-to-fill positions.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring MIS.
* Track and report key recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, source effectiveness, interview-to-selection ratio, and offer-to-joining ratio.

2. HR Operations & Employee Management

* Manage employee onboarding, documentation, attendance, leave records, and employee data.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, and other HR-related documentation.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, employee records, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Address employee queries and support employee engagement and basic employee relations.
* Maintain HR records and ensure compliance with applicable company policies and statutory requirements.
* Assist in developing, implementing, and improving HR policies, processes, and standard operating procedures.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. An MBA or PGDM in HR will be an advantage.
* 3–5 years of relevant HR experience, with a strong focus on recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Proven experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment and delivering hiring targets.
* Prior experience hiring for IT, cloud, cybersecurity, technology sales, channel sales, or specialised business roles will be preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter or LinkedIn sourcing, Naukri, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.
* Excellent candidate sourcing, screening, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, recruitment trackers, HRMS platforms, or applicant tracking systems.
* A proactive, accountable, and results-driven approach, with a strong emphasis on follow-ups and timely closures.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise hiring requirements, and collaborate directly with management and business teams.

Why Join Pioneer Global Solutions?

* **Ownership and impact:** Take the lead in strengthening and building our recruitment function.
* **Direct management interaction:** Work closely with leadership and hiring managers on business-critical hiring requirements.
* **Technology exposure:** Recruit across dynamic technology domains, including cloud, cybersecurity, AI, software, and IT infrastructure.
* **Opportunity to build processes:** Help establish scalable recruitment practices, talent pipelines, and HR systems as the organisation grows.
* **A hands-on role:** Make a measurable contribution to team building, hiring efficiency, and organisational growth.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of hiring outcomes, follows through on commitments, builds strong candidate relationships, and understands that recruitment is not just about filling positions—it is about bringing the right people into the organisation at the right time.

If you are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys recruitment, thrives on targets, and is ready to take ownership of both talent acquisition and core HR operations, we would like to hear from you.

**Apply now to join Pioneer Global Solutions.**

Organized and able to juggle multiple requests and deadlines in a high-volume environment

description:
**Company Description**  

At Smiths we apply leading\-edge technology to design, manufacture and deliver smarter engineering solutions for mission\-critical applications, solving some of the world's toughest problems for our customers, our communities and our world. Working across infrastructure, networking and cloud technologies, you will help deliver reliable, secure and modern services for colleagues worldwide while contributing to technology improvement and transformation initiatives.


We are looking for a proactive individual who takes ownership, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and is motivated to identify opportunities to improve the user experience, resolve problems and help colleagues succeed.

* Proactively ensure high levels of systems and infrastructure availability

* Support the management and optimisation of LAN and wireless infrastructure (Cisco / Meraki)

* Identify opportunities to improve network and wireless performance

* Identify opportunities to enhance infrastructure services, processes and user experience

* Maintain productive relationships with strategic vendors including AT\&T and other third\-party technology partners

* Experience supporting Wintel infrastructure, including Windows Server administration, patching and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and identity management
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, identity lifecycle management and hybrid identity solutions
* Experience or exposure to Azure Local (HCI) environments and their integration with on\-premises and cloud infrastructure
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and performance issues within a remote support environment
* Understanding of networking fundamentals; CCNA certification or equivalent practical experience is advantageous
* Knowledge of Cisco LAN, Cisco Wireless, Cisco Prime and Cisco ISE products and services would be beneficial
* Experience with tools such as SolarWinds, BMC Helix, BeyondTrust PRA or Guardicore is desirable
* Ability to collaborate effectively across networking, server, cloud and identity teams
* Knowledge of ITIL methodology; ITIL certification is advantageous
* A willingness to learn new technologies and continually develop technical expertise
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality outcomes
* Proactive approach to identifying, investigating and resolving issues
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer\-focused mindset
